payload.markdown: DST clock-injection implemented. Applied all 19 ordered_edits EXCEPT step 13 (skipped per Revision B). Plus 3 adversarial revisions: (A) virtualized 3 event-queue timestamp WRITERS at state_machine.ts ~247/260/277 (Date.now->this.clock()) to match the reader at L496, fixing the CRITICAL writer/reader clock-mix bug; (B) SKIPPED step 13 region-initial sort (kept Object.keys()[0] insertion-order fallback; safe step 12 for-in->for...of applied); (C) gated transitionTimeout .finally(clearTimer) cleanup behind schedulerProvided so the default no-scheduler path stays byte-identical. Also fixed a pre-existing latent zero-timestamp bug in resumeTimers (entryTime || now -> entryTime ?? now / === undefined) so a valid virtual entry time of 0 is preserved; default Date.now path unchanged. New exports: scheduler.ts Clock type + createVirtualScheduler; index.ts re-exports both. types.ts: ITimerScheduler.process?(now?) and StateMachineOptions.clock?.

Modified: src/types.ts, src/scheduler.ts, src/state_machine.ts, src/index.ts, src/tests/concurrency.test.ts (2 vacuous tests rewritten with real transition-count assertions, sleep-in-onEnter removed), src/tests/event_queue.test.ts (reentrant-invoke test: sleep(50) replaced with virtual clock + scheduler.process()), README.md (new '## Deterministic testing (DST)' section after Extension Points). Created: src/tests/dst.test.ts (12 deterministic tests #1-#11 per test_plan + #12 pinning the schedulerProvided unstarted-real-scheduler routing contract).

Verification: `bun run check` GREEN (biome + tsc --noEmit + knip --no-progress; knip silent => new public re-exports createVirtualScheduler/Clock cause no unused-export warnings). `bun run test` GREEN: 30 test files, 391 tests passing (was 390; +1 from added DST #12). Full existing suite passing proves byte-identical default behavior. DST flush helper uses 16 microtask iterations to settle chained invoke->raiseEvent->processQueues transitions. Mutation check performed and reverted: reverting the schedulerProvided routing in setTimer makes DST #12 FAIL (proving the test exercises the explicit-scheduler path, not vacuously passing); DST #1/#5 still pass under that mutation because the virtual scheduler reports isActive()===true, which is why #12 was added to pin the unstarted-real-scheduler contract. public_surface.test.ts ratchet unaffected (createDefaultScheduler still NOT re-exported; createVirtualScheduler allowed as growth). ABI test for ITimerScheduler still passes (process? is optional). NOT committed per instructions.

Verified by dst.test.ts #1-#12. (scheduler.ts, types.ts); #4 transitionTimeout via scheduler gated by schedulerProvided (state_machine.ts:1788). Revision A: queue timestamp writers 247/260/277 virtualized (CRITICAL reader/writer coherence). Revision B: region-initial sort #1318 NOT applied (insertion-order deterministic). Revision C: .finally(clearTimer) gated behind schedulerProvided => default path byte-identical. HARD CONSTRAINT satisfied: full pre-existing suite green (391/391). Adversarially reviewed: 8/8 correctness points PASS; 2 found defects (phantom sm.start() JSDoc, orphan block) fixed. check (biome+tsc+knip) green, test 391/391 green — re-verified independently in main session.

What went well: out-of-band audit (4 agents) + design workflow with adversarial critique caught a CRITICAL writer/reader clock-mix bug BEFORE implementation; mutation-check drove adding DST test #12. Library was ~80% DST-friendly already (no PRNG, pure guards) — only the wallclock timer-path needed seams. Lessons: (1) reader/writer clock coherence must be virtualized together (queue timestamps) — a half-virtualized path is worse than none; (2) byte-identical default is best preserved via an explicit schedulerProvided dual-path rather than changing the default path; (3) the original 'timing is only telemetry, LOW' assessment was incomplete — it missed the timer path (stateEntryTimes/resumeTimers + snapshot/restore) which IS behavioral. F-S-1 applied during REFLECT: added intentional-wall-clock comment to the telemetry Date.now() site (state_machine.ts:2044) to prevent a future 'virtualize all clocks' sweep from breaking monitor durations.
